criteria.description: The backup run records whether retention was applied.
criteria.evidence: WP01. prune_exit_code added to write_state_pointer. tests/office2/restic_backup/test_pointer_emission.py EXECUTES the script with mountpoint/restic/du stubbed and asserts the field on the happy path and on prune failure.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: A run that never reached the prune is distinguishable from one that pruned cleanly.
criteria.evidence: WP01. PRUNE_RC initialises to 127, matching the existing BACKUP_RC convention and deliberately not null (a non-integer is skipped by _explicit_error and would read healthy). Asserted for all four pre-prune exit paths: unmounted, repo inaccessible, backup failed, plus an is-integer check across every branch.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: A recorded prune failure makes the component unhealthy.
criteria.evidence: WP02. _PRUNE_OK_EXIT_CODES={0}, separate from the backup's {0,3}. tests/canary/test_probes_prune.py drives the REAL run_probe: 0 healthy; 1, 3 and 127 all unhealthy. The 3 case is the one a careless implementation gets wrong by reusing the backup set.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: Repo/host divergence of the backup script is detected and reported.
criteria.evidence: WP03. backup_script_drift.compare() with match/drift/inconclusive verdicts; 23 tests including differing files, missing, unreadable, symlinked, and directory-in-place-of-file.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: Comparator health is observable, including inconclusive.
criteria.evidence: WP03+WP05. Pointer judged by the real run_probe at review: match ok=True; drift, inconclusive, and an unrecognised status word all ok=False; aged past bound stale=True. The unrecognised-word case passes only because success_status_values is declared.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: Recovery needs no hand-written header strip.
criteria.evidence: WP04. split_header() is the single implementation; strip_header delegates and a test asserts it contains no duplicate sentinel logic. --emit-body round-trips byte-identically to the original crontab -l input, including CRLF, non-UTF-8, and a body containing the sentinel.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: The recovery procedure lives where an operator looks.
criteria.evidence: WP05. New docs/runbooks/crontab-recovery.md, indexed in docs/INDEX.md and DEVELOPER_PORTAL.md, naming the superseded grep form and why it is wrong.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: The backup script's deploy story is written down.
criteria.evidence: WP05. restic-backup-ops.md records it as manual by decision with the #899 reason; discipline.md and office2-deploy-paths.md record it as a narrow named exception; scripts/deploy/lib/README.md points at it.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: A backup with no usable snapshot timestamp is not healthy.
criteria.evidence: WP02. Guard requires _parse_iso() to succeed, not merely a non-empty string — a first attempt allowed 'not-a-date' through and it still fell back to script_finished_at_utc. Tests cover null, absent, whitespace, unparseable, and numeric, plus two non-restic pointers proving the change is scoped.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

criteria.description: The privileged install verifies its source.
criteria.evidence: WP05. restic-backup-ops.md documents checking the source against the reviewed commit and a clean working tree BEFORE sudo install, then comparing hashes after. Protecting the destination while sourcing from a claude-writable checkout leaves the same boundary weak one step upstream.
criteria.notes: Verified at WP review; see evidence.

negative_invariants.description: /data/services/backup/scripts/ MUST stay non-claude-writable — the mission must not automate the backup-script install (spec C-001, C-002).
negative_invariants.notes: No deploy artifact may reference that path at all. A claude-writable directory on a NOPASSWD sudo path is equivalent to NOPASSWD: ALL, which was #899.

negative_invariants.description: The prune good-set MUST NOT be merged into the backup's {0,3} (spec C-006).
negative_invariants.verification_command: python3 -c "from scripts.canary.probes import _PRUNE_OK_EXIT_CODES as p, _RESTIC_OK_EXIT_CODES as r; assert p==frozenset({0}) and p!=r"
negative_invariants.notes: restic forget exiting 3 means snapshots could not be removed; accepting it would pass a prune that never applied retention.

negative_invariants.description: There MUST be exactly one implementation of where the crontab header ends (spec C-004).
negative_invariants.notes: strip_header must delegate to split_header, and a header-format change that breaks recovery must fail the suite.

negative_invariants.description: No new or modified health check may be incapable of failing (spec NFR-001).
negative_invariants.notes: Every added check is asserted unhealthy for its failure condition through the real run_probe, not a reimplementation.
